The identity p_(2r-1)=x*p_(r-1)^2 proves root multiplicities; Q^2=I+xQ proves v_x(1+p_(n-2))=2^(v2(n)-1) for n divisible by four. Entry valuations imply each case in the claimed block table; Fitting decomposition proves the entire transient-shell formula. The supplied edge-built exact GF2 verifier passed 960 parameter pairs, 7413 rank-power checks, 36 characteristic-polynomial comparisons and 28688 exhaustive states. Finite coverage is explicitly separate from proof.

value.rationale: A characteristic polynomial fixes total periodic population but not nilpotent transient Jordan chains; whether a natural connected graph can share the finite-field spectrum of disjoint paths while having substantially different recurrence depth is a structural graph-dynamics question. The theorem answers it completely for every cycle length n>=3 and tail length m>=1, including all entry-time populations. The balanced dyadic family n=m=2^k has maximum transient 2^(k-1) versus 2^k-1 on the spectrally matched paths, a large, unbounded difference; m=2 instead increases the depth by two. These are not arbitrary isolated computations and the result extends beyond known real-spectrum recurrences.
